text_block_list.text:
I go looking for Taiki Shuttle, who has<n>yet to turn up
for training...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: There ya are, Trainer! Finally! C'mon,<n>let's go!
choice_data_list: I've been looking all over for you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Is this that telepathy thing? Our<n>hearts must
be beatin' to the same<n>drum or something!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Anyhoo, let's get to the finish line!

Taiki goes speeding off, leaving me<n>no choice but to
chase after her...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. You can bet your bottom<n>dollar on that!
Scavenger hunt or<n>what—I ain't fixin' to lose!
choice_data_list: Playing hooky for a game, are we?
Playing hooky for a game, are we?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yikes! You look madder than a wet<n>hen!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But game or not, it's a competition,<n>and I play to
win!

Apparently, Taiki was tasked with<n>finding someone
really reliable for her<n>scavenger hunt.
...I suppose I don't need to scold herfor that long.
